name: hubSerial
label: Hub serial number
help: Use the serial of the gateway device (the hub, or the Zappi or Eddi acting as one) shown under **Products** in [myenergi myaccount](https://myaccount.myenergi.com).

pattern.message: Enter the serial number digits only, e.g. 12345678

name: apiKey
label: API key
help: Generate a key in [myenergi myaccount](https://myaccount.myenergi.com) under **Products → Gateway Device → Advanced**. Generating a new key revokes the previous one.

name: server
label: Server
help: Leave blank unless myenergi support has given you a specific server, e.g. s18.myenergi.net.
